✨ FRIDAY BLESSINGS IS BACK! 💚

Join us for next week’s Friday Blessings as we reflect on:

🌿 Rabiul Akhir: Istiqamah
Small Deeds, Big Impact

🗓️ Friday, 25 September 2026
🕒 3.00 PM
📍 Masjid Darul Ghufran, Level 3 Youth Hub

✨ FREE! Open to all youths.
🧋 Limited bubble tea giveaway!

Bring a friend and join us for an afternoon of meaningful reminders and good company. See you there, insyaAllah 🫡
